name: Call of Nature
source:
You play as a young man who has just arrived to the city from the mountains where he has lived all his life. In his new home he will meet a loving family while he studies at the academy, a place full of temptations and dangers.

Soon the city will corrupt him with its lustful pleasures or he will remain faithful to his principles and find true love. It's up to you.

[From [url=https://hyperbolic-flower.itch.io/call-of-nature]Itch.io[/url]]
